summary: FC Cincinnati beat Inter Miami 1-0 at DRV PNK Stadium on Oct 7, 2023, officially eliminating Inter Miami from MLS playoff contention. Inter Miami dominated the first half and hit the woodwork four times but could not score, while Drake Callender made several saves before Alvaro Barreal's 78th-minute rebound goal. Lionel Messi, back from a four-game injury absence, came off the bench for about 35 minutes but could not change the result, and the note also covers supporter protests over 2024 ticket prices.
one_line: FC Cincinnati's 1-0 win at Inter Miami, with a Barreal goal, eliminated Inter Miami from the 2023 MLS playoffs despite Lionel Messi's late return.
key_facts: FC Cincinnati beat Inter Miami 1-0 at DRV PNK Stadium in Ft. Lauderdale, with Alvaro Barreal scoring in the 78th minute (listed as 79th min in the updates).
The result, with CF Montreal beating Portland, mathematically eliminated Inter Miami from MLS playoff contention with two matches left in the season.
Inter Miami hit the woodwork three times in the first half-hour (Tomas Aviles, Josef Martinez, Benja Cremaschi) and four times overall, the fourth being a late Messi free kick off the crossbar.

Drake Callender made multiple saves for Inter Miami, including a double save in the 50th minute and a stop on Brandon Vazquez in the 67th, but could not stop Barreal's follow-up after parrying Yuya Kubo's shot.
Lionel Messi, who missed the last four games due to injury, replaced Tomas Aviles in the 55th minute and played about 35 minutes.
FC Cincinnati had already clinched the Supporters' Shield, confirmed on Wednesday despite a defeat.
FC Cincinnati head coach Pat Noonan said at halftime his team showed "a lack of courage on the ball", "as bad as its been all year."

Luciano Acosta had 16 goals and 13 assists, 29 total goal contributions, the best in MLS, ahead of Thiago Almada (27) and Hany Mukhtar (25); he trailed Denis Bouanga by one goal in the Golden Boot race.

Inter Miami supporters' groups, known as La Familia, sat quietly before kickoff to protest large 2024 season ticket price increases; a planned protest was called off after the club offered to meet them.
Messi was nominated for MLS Newcomer of the Year and MLS MVP; the author notes he had one goal and two assists in 247 minutes of MLS league play.
Kickoff was at 7:39 p.m. ET; the referee was Rubiel Vazquez and the match streamed on Apple TV+ (MLS Season Pass).
Jordi Alba (hamstring) and Leonardo Campana (muscle injury) were out for Inter Miami; Alvas Powell was suspended for FC Cincinnati, with Santiago Arias at right-back.
